logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient between the water and octanol phases was detected using the “shake-flask” method. The water and octanol phases were saturated. Ru4 was dissolved in phase A. Next, this solution was mixed with an equal volume of phase B for 24 h using a mixer. Phase A was then separated from phase B. The concentrations of Ru1–Ru4 were determined by UV–vis spectroscopy using the extinction coefficients of the complexes in water saturated with octanol. The log Po/w value was calculated according to eq 5: log Po/w = log(c[X]oct) - log(c[X]PBS)
